responses.text: Oliver's head is as good as mine!
Is it true the fighting outside has stopped already?
Upstairs, or down? If I were a coward, where would I hide?
Make good use of cover. The time to strike is when they reload.
Their guns aren't quite as effective in these close quarters.
Soon this place will belong to the Legion.
I've added eight notches to my belt already. How many for you?
